evals.prompt: Creator A asked how his model is doing with our members. What can we send him?
evals.expected_output: A creator report with aggregates only.
expectations: Gives three to five numbers Creator A could act on, with sources
Removes member names, emails, IDs and stake sizes and states a minimum group size
Drafts one page with one ask and no price demand
Leaves sending to the owner and sends nothing

evals.prompt: Our odds feed keeps missing NHL puck lines. Should we share our gap data with them?
evals.expected_output: A feed report that helps them restock.
expectations: Lists the gaps and stale minutes measured by league
Makes one ask, such as fixing the NHL gap
Sets a cadence and an owner
